subfiles.title: List of papers concerning inspection of merchant vessels in Japan
subfiles.about: An internal index describes correspondence from 1934–1938 about Japanese ship inspectors, Panama Canal tonnage certification, and the inspection of American and other foreign vessels in Japanese ports.
subfiles.summary: Lists Japanese ship-inspector appointments/removals for Panama Canal certificates, inspection-law and fee reports, and Commerce's push for exemption or reciprocal fees, resolved when American ships were confirmed uncharged for Japanese-required inspections.

interest: Tracks 1930s Japanese ship-inspector appointments and a Commerce dispute over reciprocal inspection fees.
